# Exit codes

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/gen_exit_codes.py` from `shape.cli.exitcodes`. Do not edit. -->

Every `shape` command ends with one of the codes below. The classes are the same everywhere:

| Code | Class |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | a check failed, drift was found, a signature or leak scan failed |
| 2 | bad input: a missing or unreadable file, the wrong kind of file, a bad argument |
| 3 and above | the command's own verdict (a failed certificate, contract or compatibility check) |

Writing a report (`--junit`, `--sarif`, `--json`) never changes a command's exit code, and a
command's `--help` ends with the same table. `shape` itself exits 2 for an argument that does not
parse, and 130 when a scale run is interrupted. See `docs/CLI.md` and `docs/CI.md`.
